```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide")

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
has_input_file <- !is.null(input_file) &&
  length(input_file) > 0 &&
  !is.na(input_file) &&
  nzchar(input_file)

if (has_input_file) {
  input_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = FALSE))
  project_dir <- if (basename(input_dir) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    normalizePath(input_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
  }
} else {
  cwd <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  project_dir <- if (basename(cwd) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(cwd, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    cwd
  }
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
setwd(project_dir)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tximport)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(WGCNA)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(Mfuzz)
  library(Biobase)
  library(scales)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(jsonlite)
})


options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::allowWGCNAThreads()

rdata_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "RData")
dir.create(rdata_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

rds_file <- function(name) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
}

cache_or_run <- function(name, expr, refresh = FALSE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (file.exists(path) && !refresh) {
    message("Loading cached object: ", path)
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    message("Running and saving object: ", path)
    value <- force(expr)
    saveRDS(value, path)
    value
  }
}

load_rds_object <- function(name, required = TRUE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (required) stop("Missing cached object: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  readRDS(path)
}

load_rds_list <- function(name, required = TRUE, envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  value <- load_rds_object(name, required = required)
  if (!is.null(value)) list2env(value, envir = envir)
  invisible(value)
}

analysis_file <- function(...) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
}

input_file_path <- function(...) {
  cached <- file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
  if (file.exists(cached)) return(cached)
  file.path(project_dir, ...)
}

show_table <- function(x, n = 20, title = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    cat("\n### ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No object available.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No rows.\n")
    return(invisible(df))
  }
  print(utils::head(df, n))
  invisible(df)
}

show_plot_files <- function(paths) {
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  paths <- normalizePath(paths, mustWork = TRUE)
  knitr::include_graphics(paths)
}
```

```{r load-upstream}
gene_module_df <- load_rds_object("06_gene_module_df")
gene_module_df_clean <- as_tibble(gene_module_df) %>%
  mutate(Gene = as.character(Gene), Module = as.character(Module))

module_enrichment <- read_tsv(
  analysis_file("WGCNA_TCR_NLR_module_enrichment", "WGCNA_module_TCR_NLR_enrichment.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

load_rds_list("07_annotation_background")
go_metadata <- load_rds_object("08_go_metadata")
list2env(go_metadata, envir = .GlobalEnv)
term2name <- load_rds_object("09_kegg_term2name")
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Step Y. KEGG enrichment for top NLR-enriched modules
##  Modules selected by DE-TCR-NLR enrichment FDR
##  (replaces the old blue/turquoise/red loop).
############################################################

outdir_kegg <- analysis_file("KEGG_top_modules_NEW")
dir.create(outdir_kegg, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

modules_to_plot <- module_enrichment %>%
  filter(DE_TCR_NLR >= 2) %>%
  arrange(FDR_DE_TCR, desc(FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR), desc(DE_TCR_density)) %>%
  head(8) %>%
  pull(Module)

cat("Modules to KEGG-enrich:", paste(modules_to_plot, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

for (mod in modules_to_plot) {
  
  target_genes <- gene_module_df_clean %>%
    dplyr::filter(Module == mod) %>%
    pull(Gene)
  
  if (length(target_genes) < 5) {
    message("Skipped ", mod, " - too few genes")
    next
  }
  
  kegg_res <- enricher(
    gene = target_genes,
    TERM2GENE   = gene2kegg,
    TERM2NAME   = term2name,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    qvalueCutoff = 0.2
  )
  
  if (is.null(kegg_res) || nrow(kegg_res) == 0) {
    message("Module ", mod, ": no significant KEGG pathway")
    next
  }
  
  p_kegg <- dotplot(
    kegg_res,
    showCategory = 15,
    title = paste("KEGG Enrichment -", mod, "Module")
  )
  
  print(p_kegg)
  
  ggsave(file.path(outdir_kegg, paste0("KEGG_", mod, ".pdf")),
         p_kegg, width = 9, height = 6)
  ggsave(file.path(outdir_kegg, paste0("KEGG_", mod, ".png")),
         p_kegg, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  
  write_tsv(as.data.frame(kegg_res),
            file.path(outdir_kegg, paste0("KEGG_", mod, "_table.tsv")))
}
```
```{r}
############################################################
## Step Y-2. GO BP enrichment for top NLR-enriched modules
##   compensates for KEGG misses (lightyellow, green, sienna2, etc.)
############################################################


outdir_go <- analysis_file("GO_BP_top_modules_NEW")
dir.create(outdir_go, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

cat("Modules to GO-BP-enrich:", paste(modules_to_plot, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

go_bp_results <- list()

for (mod in modules_to_plot) {
  
  target_genes <- gene_module_df_clean %>%
    dplyr::filter(Module == mod) %>%
    pull(Gene)
  
  if (length(target_genes) < 5) {
    message("Skipped ", mod, " - too few genes")
    next
  }
  
go_res <- enricher(
    gene         = target_genes,
    universe     = gene_module_df_clean$Gene,
    TERM2GENE    = gene2go,
    TERM2NAME    = go2name,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    qvalueCutoff = 0.2
  )
  if (is.null(go_res) || nrow(go_res) == 0) {
    message("Module ", mod, ": no significant GO term")
    next
  }
  
  go_bp_results[[mod]] <- go_res
  
  p_go <- dotplot(
    go_res,
    showCategory = 15,
    title = paste("GO enrichment -", mod, "Module")
  )
  
  print(p_go)
  
  ggsave(file.path(outdir_go, paste0("GO_", mod, ".pdf")),
         p_go, width = 9, height = 6.5)
  ggsave(file.path(outdir_go, paste0("GO_", mod, ".png")),
         p_go, width = 9, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
  write_tsv(as.data.frame(go_res),
            file.path(outdir_go, paste0("GO_", mod, "_table.tsv")))
}

if (length(go_bp_results) > 0) {
  go_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(go_bp_results, function(res, mod) {
    as.data.frame(res) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>%
      head(5) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Module = mod) %>%
      dplyr::select(Module, ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio,
                    pvalue, p.adjust, Count)
  })
  
  write_tsv(go_summary,
            file.path(outdir_go, "GO_top5_per_module_summary.tsv"))
  
  cat("\n===== Top-5 GO BP terms per module =====\n")
  print(go_summary)
}
```

```{r display-key-results, results='markup', echo=FALSE}
show_table(
  tibble(Module = modules_to_plot),
  n = 20,
  title = "Modules included in top-module functional enrichment"
)
if (exists("go_summary")) {
  show_table(go_summary, n = 30, title = "Top GO terms per module")
}

kegg_tables <- list.files(outdir_kegg, pattern = "_table[.]tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(kegg_tables) > 0) {
  kegg_preview <- purrr::map_dfr(kegg_tables, function(path) {
    read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 5) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Module = sub("^KEGG_(.*)_table[.]tsv$", "\\1", basename(path)), .before = 1)
  })
  show_table(kegg_preview, n = 30, title = "Top KEGG terms per module")
}
```
